pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with jagged, high-frequency serration along the edges. Geometric shapes on the mid-flank are larger and more elongated than the smaller, more densely packed patches on the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous cream-colored interstitial network with prominent tri-radial and tetra-radial junction nodes. Pixel thickness of pathways is relatively uniform on the upper flank but exhibits significant widening at the ventral transition.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane displays a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the neck, transitioning into a smoother, lower-profile contour at the shoulder junction.
